title: Kiritani Haruka — Summer! Training Camp! Swimsuit!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great practice today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Rin
rows.Line: Great practice!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I really appreciate you girls coming over here so often recently. It's been so fun to practice all these things that require an ensemble.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Likewise.
These practices have become a wonderful learning experience. We've been able to try so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, since I'm also hammering out the details for what we'll be doing during our training camp. I'll have to make a note of everything we've done.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, you mentioned that before.
How's that coming along?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have a good idea of what kinds of activities and exercises we'll be doing for what purposes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right now, I'm working out the details for those things.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
Does that mean you've picked out a location for us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I've got a place picked out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You do?! Where?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe... Since it's summer and we're doing a training camp...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There's only one choice!
The beach!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, the beach!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No fair. A training camp at the beach sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and sprinting on the beach would be such a nice leg workout!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. We could work on our stamina with some swimming and maybe even have a little triathlon event.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I guess our definitions of “fun” all vary slightly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Slightly? I'd say a lot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
Haruka, there's something I've been meaning to ask you and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you wanna ask?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm trying to keep these activities a secret and planning everything on my own, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. None of us know what we'll be doing and won't be rehearsing anything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being in the dark is also supposed to give Minori an opportunity to learn how to keep a watchful eye and think on her feet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our main objectives for this training camp will be to improve our teamwork and have Minori work on the things you just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, we'll be streaming for nearly 24 hours, so we'll need to do activities that everyone's gonna want to watch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: True. Simply doing 100 sit-ups and such probably won't be very interesting to our fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I'm asking MEIKO for some advice while trying to figure out how to spice things up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope you're looking forward to an intense workout and feeling the pump♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yay...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It is pretty intense, but there are some things that still concern me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is where we come in...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I went looking for someone to give me an objective opinion to see whether or not the activities I came up with are actually fun and entertaining.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was how I ended up contacting this scriptwriter who I met when I was still on the Wide World of Laughs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right. Because you still can't tell the others about what you'll be doing yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They gave me a quote for their consultation fee, and I think it's a reasonable amount... What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, that seems fine...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, you decided that you need the help of this writer after coming up with a list of ideas?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, since we're not on the rooftop this time. Since we'll be shooting on location, I knew that we'd have to get permission and have a bunch of other stuff ready. However, this is my first time doing any of that on my own.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right... For the Christmas event we did the other day, Namamin's agency took care of all of those things for us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think asking someone you trust about this was the correct decision.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'll discuss things with them and do my best to make this a really incredible training camp!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, you're always free to ask us for help if you think you ever need it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm always willing to lend a hand!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! In that case, I might just have you run an extra five kilometers as prep for our training camp, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! How does that count as helping?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I was joking.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what your training camp's gonna be like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me neither. It might be fun to also start thinking about what we'll be doing for the after party♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
No, I completely forgot about that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I got so caught up in planning for our training camp that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, hold on. We can't have you be the one planning everything from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, why don't you leave that to me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna help with that too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay, Airi. That way, you'll be able to focus on our training camp, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Isn't this what having teammates is all about, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Okay, I'll leave that to you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to a super fun after party!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Of course, you can count on us!
